findings.claim: The dual-mode template listing is subsumed by the equality check.
findings.advisorVerdict: Worker declined with a reason the advisor accepted: the equality check is source-checkout-only, so in both installed deployments this count is the only assertion that a fourth file has not appeared under templates/.

findings.claim: Per-block [[ -f ]] guards are subsumed by the existence loop.

findings.claim: The find pipeline is generic-filename machinery for a closed three-name set.
findings.advisorVerdict: Accepted as taste, deliberately not actioned. The function is verified correct across six behavioral cases; churning a boot-path file for three lines is not worth the risk this late in the build. Disclosed rather than silently dropped.

findings.claim: The contract and the templates restate the same routing facts in several places.
findings.advisorVerdict: Partly by design and the reviewer said so: a template becomes the live file an operator reads without the contract open. Not actioned.
